zh: 世界显示启动，但大厅搜不到房间
直连代码也无法进入
en: Worlds appear running but the lobby cannot find the room
Direct connect also fails

zh: 查看 server_log.txt 是否出现 E_INVALID_TOKEN
en: Check server_log.txt for E_INVALID_TOKEN

zh: Klei 游戏令牌无效或与房间不匹配
en: The Klei game token is invalid or does not match the room

zh: 进入房间设置，更换正确的游戏令牌
也可以使用平台默认游戏令牌
重启房间
en: Open room settings and replace the game token
Alternatively, use the platform default game token
Restart the room

reason.zh: 日志显示游戏令牌失效，可改用平台默认游戏令牌
reason.en: The log shows the game token is invalid; use the platform default game token

reason.zh: 更换令牌后需要重启房间才能生效
reason.en: Restart the room after changing the token

risk.zh: 更换令牌后需要等待大厅重新注册，期间玩家可能搜不到房间
risk.en: The lobby needs time to re-register; players may not find the room immediately

zh: 世界启动后很快变为未启动
日志出现 Lua 或 LoadPrefabFile 报错
en: A world starts and then stops
Logs contain Lua or LoadPrefabFile errors

zh: 在 server_log.txt 中查找 error calling LoadPrefabFile in mod workshop-
en: Search server_log.txt for error calling LoadPrefabFile in mod workshop-

zh: 模组文件缺失或版本不兼容
modoverrides.lua 配置损坏
en: The mod file is missing or incompatible
modoverrides.lua is corrupted

zh: 禁用日志中报错的模组
重启世界
确认其他模组依赖是否满足
en: Disable the mod reported in the log
Restart the world
Check mod dependencies

reason.zh: 日志显示该模组加载失败
reason.en: The log shows this mod failed to load

risk.zh: 禁用模组可能影响存档内容，请先确认该模组不是存档必需模组
risk.en: Disabling a mod may affect the save; confirm it is not required

zh: 世界显示启动，但无法进入
日志出现 Lua stack traceback 或 attempt to call global
en: Worlds appear running but cannot be entered
Logs contain a Lua stack traceback or attempt to call global

zh: 在日志中查找 LUA ERROR stack traceback
记录日志中的 session/xxxxx 存档编号
en: Search logs for LUA ERROR stack traceback
Note the session/xxxxx ID in the log

zh: 存档数据损坏，通常是某个模组或异常退出导致
en: Save data is corrupted, often caused by a mod or abnormal shutdown

zh: 备份当前存档
删除日志中提到的存档文件，强制回档
重启世界
en: Back up the current save
Delete the save file mentioned in the log to force a rollback
Restart the world

reason.zh: 日志显示指定存档损坏
reason.en: The log shows the specified save is corrupted

risk.zh: 删除存档不可逆；执行前会自动备份，并要求输入房间名确认
risk.en: Deleting a save is irreversible; a backup is created and the room name must be typed to confirm

zh: 平台磁盘剩余空间低于 5GB
日志或存档可能写入失败
en: Less than 5GB free on the platform disk
Logs or saves may fail to write

zh: 查看平台磁盘剩余空间
检查日志目录和备份目录占用
en: Check free disk space
Check log and backup directory usage

zh: 日志、备份或存档占用过多磁盘
en: Logs, backups, or saves are using too much disk

zh: 清理过期日志
清理旧备份
扩容磁盘
en: Clean old logs
Clean old backups
Expand the disk

risk.zh: 清理日志不会删除存档，但会丢失历史日志
risk.en: Cleaning logs does not delete saves, but historical logs are lost

zh: 游戏无法启动
游戏日志没有任何输出
游戏无法连接
en: The game cannot start
The game log has no output at all
The game cannot be connected to

zh: 查看 DST 安装目录和启动脚本是否完整
手动执行启动命令，观察终端输出（游戏日志为空时，报错通常只出现在终端或平台系统日志中）
检查 DST 运行所需的系统依赖库（如 libstdc++、libcurl）是否已安装
en: Check that the DST install directory and startup scripts are complete
Run the startup command manually and watch the terminal output; when the game log is empty, errors usually appear only in the terminal or platform system log
Check that the system libraries DST requires (such as libstdc++ and libcurl) are installed

zh: DST 安装文件缺失或损坏，进程在写入游戏日志前就已退出
DST 运行所需的系统依赖库缺失或损坏
en: DST install files are missing or corrupted, so the process exits before writing the game log
The system libraries DST requires are missing or corrupted

zh: 重新安装游戏（重新下载 DST 服务器文件）
重新安装 DST 运行所需的系统依赖库
en: Reinstall the game (download the DST server files again)
Reinstall the system libraries DST requires

risk.zh: 重新安装会重新下载游戏文件，耗时较长，并可能覆盖安装目录中的手动改动；操作前建议备份存档与配置
risk.en: Reinstalling downloads the game files again, takes a long time, and may overwrite manual changes in the install directory; back up saves and configs first

zh: 游戏正常启动并且正常注册
游戏日志无异常
检查世界通过
连接游戏时提示“这个服务器使用了旧版本的游戏”
en: The game starts and registers normally
The game log has no errors
The world check passes
Connecting shows "This server is using an older version of the game"

zh: 用版本检查工具比较 DST 本地版本与远端版本，确认 gameVersionOutdated 是否为 true
确认客户端游戏版本是否已更新到最新版本
en: Use the version check tool to compare the local and remote DST versions and confirm whether gameVersionOutdated is true
Check whether the game client is already on the latest version

zh: DST 服务器文件未更新，本地版本低于最新版本
客户端已更新到新版本，服务器仍运行旧版本
en: The DST server files were not updated and are older than the latest version
The client is updated but the server still runs an older version

zh: 更新游戏（通过 SteamCMD 更新 DST 服务器文件）
重启游戏，让服务器加载新版本
en: Update the game (update the DST server files via SteamCMD)
Restart the game so the server loads the new version

reason.zh: 版本检查显示服务器版本低于最新版本，需要更新游戏
reason.en: The version check shows the server is older than the latest version; the game needs an update

reason.zh: 更新游戏后需要重启房间，服务器才会加载新版本
reason.en: Restart the room after updating so the server loads the new version

risk.zh: 更新游戏会通过 SteamCMD 重新下载服务器文件，耗时数分钟，仅管理员可执行；更新后必须重启房间才会加载新版本
risk.en: Updating downloads server files via SteamCMD, takes several minutes, and is admin-only; the room must be restarted afterward to load the new version

zh: 游戏无法启动
游戏无法连接
en: The game cannot start
The game cannot be connected to

zh: 在游戏日志中搜索 E_ROWID_EXIST，出现 Master Server Broadcast Error: E_ROWID_EXIST 即可确认
日志通常同时包含 [Http] Curl failed[1] with HTTP_500, retrying 与 {"Error":{"Code":"E_ROWID_EXIST"}}
en: Search the game log for E_ROWID_EXIST; Master Server Broadcast Error: E_ROWID_EXIST confirms it
The log usually also contains [Http] Curl failed[1] with HTTP_500, retrying and {"Error":{"Code":"E_ROWID_EXIST"}}

zh: 游戏令牌已被注册，Master Server 广播时行号冲突，返回 E_ROWID_EXIST
en: The game token is already registered, so the Master Server broadcast hits a row ID conflict and returns E_ROWID_EXIST

zh: 更换默认游戏令牌
重启游戏
en: Switch to the default game token
Restart the game

reason.zh: 日志出现 E_ROWID_EXIST，说明当前令牌已被注册，需要更换默认游戏令牌
reason.en: The log shows E_ROWID_EXIST, so the current token is already registered; switch to the default game token

reason.zh: 更换令牌后需要重启房间，服务器才会用新令牌重新注册
reason.en: Restart the room after changing the token so the server registers again with the new token

risk.zh: 更换令牌后需要等待大厅重新注册，期间玩家可能搜不到房间
risk.en: The lobby needs time to re-register after the token change and players may not find the room meanwhile
